request:
镜头 s40：纪录片采访镜头，时长 11 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-int78）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', '50mm']）：Locked look "2078 oral-history interview" (style preset sp01-int78): a Sony FX6 on a locked tripod; S-Cinetone; a 50mm prime at f/2.8; filter Black Pro-Mist 1/8; grade: neutral, gently warm skin, background one to two stops under the face; light: one large soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right, a small warm practical in the background; texture: clean, fine detail, real skin texture; a calm, restrained oral-history interview, the subject looking past the lens.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位，缓慢推近。宋念把笔记本翻到最后一页，抬头看着采访者，一字一句地说。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：clear, resolute, warm
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, locked-off interview camera with one slow push in
景深与虚实：Shallow depth of field, face sharp, background soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview medium shot in the dim concrete room: Nian, mid-thirties, in the same plain dark knitted sweater as in her other interviews (no uniform, no headset), sits on the metal chair with the worn notebook open on her knees at its last page, looking up from it to the interviewer. Blocking lock: Nian sits at frame centre-left, the open notebook on her knees in the lower frame; dim soft background.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Nian (a woman in her mid-thirties, low, calm, restrained voice) — 宋念（三十多岁女性的声音，低沉、平静、克制）: 最后一页他写着：规则不属于任何一个人，所以才能属于所有人。
现场环境声：quiet room tone
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
[ours/sound-room] 声音：采访间底噪
[ours/light-interview-key] 采访布光：单一柔光主光
[rules/move/locked-off] move
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

Nian sits at frame centre-left on the metal chair, the open notebook flat on her knees in the lower frame, her hands on its edges; the dim concrete wall and the small warm practical sit deep in the soft background at frame right, the interviewer off camera in that direction.
